skills.name: arrow-resource
skills.description: Kotlin + Arrow Resource lifecycle discipline with `Resource`, `ResourceScope`, `resourceScope`, and context parameters. Use for safe acquisition/release of files, streams, DB pools/connections, HTTP clients, background scopes, or multipart parts; preventing resource leaks and use-after-close bugs; designing companion `Resource` builders; using `arrow-autoclose` when only synchronous `AutoCloseable` cleanup is possible; composing resources with typed errors, cancellation, or parallel acquisition.

skills.name: arrow-typed-errors

Use when implementing or simplifying typed-error flows, translating error types, replacing verbose Either handling, validating input with accumulation, or selecting an error wrapper.

skills.name: cats-effect-io

skills.name: cats-effect-resource

skills.name: compose-state-hoisting
